# CCA Practice Platforms

> Independent practice-exam platform and study resource for Anthropic's Claude Certified Architect (CCA) Foundations certification. Not affiliated with, authorized by, or endorsed by Anthropic.

CCA Practice Platforms (claudecertifiedarchitects.com) provides unofficial practice materials for the CCA Foundations exam: a 400-question scenario-based question bank, a full-length 60-question/120-minute timed exam simulation, a free 10-question diagnostic quiz, an exam guide, and a blog covering all 5 CCA exam domains (Agentic Architecture & Orchestration, Claude Code Configuration & Workflow, Prompt Engineering & Structured Output, Tool Design & MCP, and Context Management & Reliability). The CCA Foundations exam uses a 100-1,000 scaled score with a passing score of 720. 'Claude' and 'Claude Certified Architect' are trademarks of their respective owner.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/): Overview of the practice platform, practice modes, and entry point to the question bank.
- [CCA Foundations Exam Simulation](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/cca-foundations-exam/): Full-length, 60-question, 120-minute timed practice exam covering all 5 domains with a scored breakdown.
- [Practice Questions](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/cca-practice-questions/): 400 scenario-based practice questions with explanations across all 5 domains and multiple test modes; a free 55-question sample needs no account.
- [Exam Guide](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/cca-exam-guide/): Exam format, domain weights, passing score (720/1,000), and study strategies.
- [Free Diagnostic Quiz](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/diagnostic/): 10-question, no-login readiness check with a per-domain score.
- [Official Exam Registration](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/register/): How to register for the official CCA Foundations exam via Anthropic's Skilljar portal.
- [Blog](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/): Articles on CCA exam prep, the 5 exam domains, certification value, and Claude agent development.
- [CCA Study Plan Generator](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/study-plan-generator/): Free CCA Foundations study plan generator. Enter your weeks until exam and weak domains for a personalized, exam-weighted study schedule — no signup required.
- [CCA Foundations Exam FAQ](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/faq/): Answers to the most common questions about the Claude Certified Architect (CCA) Foundations exam: cost, format, passing score, the five domains, and how to prepare.

## CCA Exam Domain Guides

- [Domain 1: Agentic Architecture & Orchestration (27%)](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/agentic-architecture-orchestration-cca-domain-1/): The highest-weighted domain — agent design patterns, orchestration, and common exam traps.
- [Domain 2: Claude Code Configuration & Workflow (20%)](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/claude-code-config-workflows-cca-domain-2/): CLAUDE.md, project setup, and workflow scenarios.
- [Domain 3: Prompt Engineering & Structured Output (20%)](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/prompt-engineering-structured-output-cca-domain-3/): Explicit criteria, few-shot prompting, tool_use with JSON schemas, validation-retry loops, and batch processing.
- [Domain 4: Tool Design & MCP (18%)](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/tool-design-mcp-cca-domain-4/): MCP server architecture, tool schema design, and tool-granularity scenarios.
- [Domain 5: Context Management & Reliability (15%)](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/context-management-reliability-cca-domain-5/): Token budgets, caching strategies, and long-conversation reliability.
- [The 5 CCA Foundations Exam Domains Explained](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/cca-foundations-exam-domains-explained/): Domain weights, key topics, and what to study for each domain.
- [Claude Certified Architect Exam Guide 2026](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/cca-foundations-exam-guide-2026/): Domain weights, sample questions, and a study timeline.
- [CCA Exam Study Schedule: 30-Day Preparation Plan](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/cca-exam-study-schedule-30-day-plan/): Weekly breakdowns and daily focus areas for a 30-day study plan.
- [10 Free CCA Practice Questions With Explanations](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/cca-foundations-exam-practice-questions-free/): Sample questions across all five domains with answer explanations.
- [CCA Exam Anti-Patterns: 7 Mistakes That Fail Candidates](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/cca-exam-anti-patterns/): Architectural anti-patterns that commonly appear on the exam.
- [How Hard Is the Claude Foundations Certification?](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/how-hard-is-cca-foundations-exam/): What makes each domain conceptually difficult, based on the exam's published structure and content depth.
- [CCA Study Tips for Domain 1: Agentic Architecture Practice](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/cca-study-tips-domain-1-agentic-architecture/): Master CCA Domain 1 with targeted study tips for agentic architecture and orchestration.
- [CCA Study Tips for Domain 2: Claude Code Config & Workflow](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/cca-study-tips-domain-2-claude-code-config-workflow/): Master CCA Domain 2 with expert study tips on Claude Code configuration, workflow automation, and project management strategies that appear on the exam.
- [CCA Study Tips for Domain 3: Prompt Engineering Mastery](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/cca-study-tips-domain-3-prompt-engineering-mastery/): Master CCA Domain 3 with proven strategies for prompt engineering, structured output, and XML formatting.
- [CCA Study Tips for Domain 4: Tool Design & MCP Mastery](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/cca-study-tips-domain-4-tool-design-mcp-mastery/): Master CCA Domain 4 with targeted study tips for tool design and Model Context Protocol.
- [CCA Study Tips for Domain 5: Context Management & Reliability](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/cca-study-tips-domain-5-context-management-reliability/): Master CCA Domain 5 with proven study strategies for context window optimization, error handling, and building reliable Claude systems that scale in production.
- [How Many Questions Is the CCA Exam?](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/how-many-questions-cca-exam/): The CCA Foundations exam has 60 scenario-based multiple-choice and multiple-response questions and a 120-minute time limit, weighted across all 5 exam domains.
- [How Much Does the CCA Exam Cost?](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/cca-exam-cost/): The CCA Foundations exam has a $125 USD standard registration fee, paid directly to Anthropic when you schedule your session.
- [What Is the CCA Exam Passing Score?](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/cca-exam-passing-score/): The CCA Foundations exam passing score is 720 out of 1,000 on Anthropic's scaled, domain-weighted scoring system — not a percentage of questions correct.
- [How Long Is the CCA Foundations Exam?](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/how-long-is-cca-foundations-exam/): The CCA Foundations exam runs 120 minutes (2 hours) for 60 scenario-based questions — about 2 minutes per question on average.
- [Is the CCA Exam Multiple Choice?](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/is-cca-exam-multiple-choice/): What the official CCAR-F (CCA-F) Exam Guide says about question format: multiple-choice and multiple-response items, and what that means for how you prepare.
- [CCA Exam Day Strategy: What to Expect and How to Succeed](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/cca-exam-day-strategy-what-to-expect/): Master the Claude Certified Architect exam day with proven strategies for time management, question analysis, and maintaining focus during the 120-minute test.
- [CCA Exam Retake Policy: Cost, Wait Time, and Strategy](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/cca-exam-retake-policy-cost-wait-time-strategy/): Learn about the CCA exam retake policy, including wait periods, additional costs, score validity, and proven strategies to pass on your second attempt.
- [CCA Domain Weighting Strategy: How to Focus Your Study Time](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/cca-domain-weighting-strategy-focus-study-time/): The CCA Foundations exam weights its five domains differently — from Agentic Architecture (27%) down to Context Management (15%). Here's how to allocate your study time by domain weight for the highest expected score.

What the two official guides state about audience, blueprint, fee and format, and how to choose between them.
- [CCDV-F vs CCAR-F: 53 items, 8 domains, same $125 fee](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/ccdv-f-vs-ccar-f-claude-developer-exam/): CCDV-F is the Claude Certified Developer – Foundations exam; CCAR-F is the Architect one. Same $125 fee and 120 minutes, but 53 items against 60, eight content domains against five, and blueprints published at different resolutions.

## Claude Development Skills

- [What's the Best Way to Learn to Build AI Agents with Claude?](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/how-to-learn-claude-agent-development/): A structured learning path for building production-grade Claude agents.
- [How to Write an Effective CLAUDE.md File](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/how-to-write-effective-claude-md-file/): Practical guide with examples, common mistakes, and exam-relevant tips.
- [Common MCP Server Design Mistakes and How to Avoid Them](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/common-mcp-server-design-mistakes-how-to-avoid/): Learn the seven most common Model Context Protocol server design mistakes that trip up CCA candidates and production architects.
- [Your coding agent's summary of its own work is not evidence](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/coding-agent-summary-not-evidence/): Four specific incidents from a real production coding session where an AI coding agent's self-report of what it did was wrong, and the session rules that force verification from outside the agent's own narration.
- [The workflow you turned off is still a load-bearing part of your system](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/disabled-workflow-still-load-bearing/): A workflow I disabled for good reasons left no record of the reason, and quietly blocked publishing for a month. What that taught me about silent absence, structured errors, and why generators must never mutate their source.
- [Six searches returned zero. Every one was broken.](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/when-a-search-returns-a-false-zero/): Six search tools reported zero matches in one week while the matches sat in front of them. What broke in each, why an empty result looks identical to a working one, and the one-line fix.
- [Your MCP Tool Errors Are Written for the Wrong Reader](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/mcp-tool-errors-wrong-reader/): An agent called a calendar tool eleven times on the same 409 because the error was written for a human reader. What a tool error should tell a model, why retryable needs idempotent, and why a schema does not save you.
